name: Blog Post Checklist
description: A blog post checklist for finalizing and publishing one post the right way.

items.text: Write a clear, compelling headline that includes the keyword.
Set an SEO title under about 60 characters.
Write a meta description that summarizes the post and invites clicks.
Create a short, readable, keyword-rich URL slug.
Choose a category and relevant tags.
Use one H1 and logical H2 and H3 subheadings.
Keep paragraphs short and break up long blocks of text.
Use bullet or numbered lists where they aid clarity.
Bold key points and add white space for easy scanning.
Add a short intro that states the value up front.
Add a relevant, high-quality featured image.
Compress images so they load quickly.
Write descriptive alt text for every image.
Use clear, keyword-aware image file names.
Confirm any embedded video or media displays correctly.
Add internal links to 2 to 4 related posts or pages.
Link to credible external sources where helpful.
Set external links to open appropriately and check they work.
Include one clear call to action for the reader's next step.
Add or check the author bio and any related-post block.
Proofread for spelling, grammar and tone.
Preview the post on mobile and desktop.
Confirm every link and button works.
Check the publish date, category and visibility settings.
Publish, then share the post to your channels.

faq.q: What should I check before publishing a blog post?
faq.a: Before publishing, confirm the title and meta description, clean formatting and headings, optimized images with alt text, internal and external links, a clear call to action, and a final proofread.

faq.q: How is this different from a content checklist?
faq.a: This blog post checklist focuses on finalizing and publishing one post. A content checklist covers the broader workflow from research through promotion across formats.

faq.q: Why does alt text matter on a blog post?
faq.a: Alt text describes images for screen readers and helps search engines understand them. Adding descriptive alt text improves accessibility and gives your images a chance to rank in image search.

faq.q: Is this blog post checklist good for beginners?
faq.a: Yes. It lists each pre-publish step in plain language, so a beginner or small business blogger can publish complete, search-friendly posts every time.

faq.q: Can I download this blog post checklist as a PDF?
faq.a: Yes. You can print it or download it as a PDF and keep it beside you as a pre-publish routine.
